trend.description: How this associate's most recent scored tasks (up to the last 10) compare to their all-time mean EfficiencyPct. INSUFFICIENT_DATA when fewer than 3 recent tasks were scored -- always present, never omitted, since "not enough data yet" is itself a meaningful signal.

coachingFlag.description: True iff this associate's 3 most recent SCORED tasks were all below the coaching floor (85% efficiency). Visibility only -- this service never automates coaching, pay, or task-claim decisions from this signal.

404.description: No task performance recorded for this associate
